create_dog_torso: create a dog model torso with thoracic spine, ribs, sternum, and lumbar vertebrae using MJCF
build_lumbar_spine_joints: build lumbar spine joints with configurable degrees of freedom per vertebra for extend, bend, and twist
add_pelvis_bones: add pelvis bones including sacrum and pelvis with left and right collision primitives
configure_torso_collision: configure ellipsoid and sphere collision primitives for the torso and lumbar vertebrae
compute_torso_com: compute the center of mass position for the torso body and adjust geometry positions accordingly
